summary.name: Mayan EDMS
summary.one_liner: Mayan EDMS is an open source electronic document management system, first introduced in 2010, with preview generation, OCR and automatic categorization.
use_cases: store and manage large document collections
run a self-hosted document management system
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Mayan EDMS as an open source document management system introduced in 2010 and claims it has the longest period of uninterrupted active development. It states the project has hundreds of thousands of active installations. The awesome-selfhosted listing on the page adds that it provides preview generation, OCR, and automatic categorization, is licensed GPL-2.0, and is deployable via Docker/Kubernetes. The page itself offers few concrete feature details beyond these claims and mentions commercial professional services such as support tiers, migration help, and training.
notable: Active development since 2010, claimed as the longest uninterrupted development period
Licensed GPL-2.0 with commercial professional services available
Offers OCR, preview generation and automatic categorization (per listing)
caveats: Commercial support, migration assistance and training are offered as paid professional services (tiers not detailed on page)
Page is mostly marketing claims with few verifiable technical details
